audience: community and course teams that manage members, courses and orders in MemberArea

useCases.title: Find a member and read their courses
useCases.text: Find a member by exact email address, or open one by id. List every course the member is enrolled in, with progress.

useCases.title: List members and tags
useCases.text: List members with search, tag, status and sync filters. List the member tags of the MemberArea.

useCases.title: Review courses and who is enrolled
useCases.text: List either the live courses or the drafts. List the members enrolled in a course, with their progress.

useCases.title: Review orders and subscriptions
useCases.text: List orders and open one by id. List subscriptions and the events in a date range.

useCases.title: Create a member and attach a tag
useCases.text: Create a new member, then attach a tag. Check by email first, because a second create makes a second member.

useCases.title: Enroll a member in a course
useCases.text: Grant a member access to a course. This changes what the member can open.
